about: Server singleton alive from the first idle level on (seen.py context: idle / act1-idle / level-change, nothing done). Belongs to esv::trap::DisarmSystem (trap disarm rolls whose result is delayed). Live: zero (never used in samples).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x2CF94D0 allocates 0x40 and zeroes a HashSet (+0..+0x30) plus the value array (+0x30..+0x40). Windows esv::trap::DisarmSystem code bg3.exe+0x2CF66B0 (reaches the singleton through its storage index, the global at bg3.exe+0x638C02C) walks esv::roll::FinishedEvent arrays (stride 0x58, RollContext byte == 5), inserts the query entity as an 8-byte key (bg3.exe+0x721030), grows the value storage with 16-byte Array values (ptr, capacity, size moved per element) and appends a 0x20-byte DisarmRollResult with bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10. macOS: ls::HashMap<ID<EntityHandleTraits>, DynamicArray<esv::trap::DisarmRollResult>>::DestroyValues among the component's ops.

survey.live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
open_questions: Member names of esv::trap::DisarmRollResult are taken from the esv::roll::FinishedEvent members they are copied from (SE Roll.h), not from the game.
survey.second_pass: Windows DisarmSystem code bg3.exe+0x2CF66B0 and its append bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 confirm the map shape and every element member (entity +0, +8, +0x10, bytes +0x18/+0x19), copied from esv::roll::FinishedEvent members Roll, Subject, SpellCheck, Canceled; found via the storage-index global at bg3.exe+0x638C02C.

fields.name: Roll
fields.evidence: Windows append bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 (stride 0x20) stores at +0 the value its second argument points to: the esv::roll::FinishedEvent's Roll entity (event +0x20; the caller bg3.exe+0x2CF66B0 passes a pointer 8 bytes before its cursor, which points at event+0x28; SE Roll.h FinishedEvent.Roll). Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0x61BC80 is the same.

fields.name: Subject
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 stores at +8 the value its third argument points to: event +0x08 (the caller's cursor minus 0x20), SE FinishedEvent.Subject.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 stores the entity of the current query row (the entity array whose pointer is at view+0x40, indexed by the row index at view+0x50) - the same entity that keys the map (get-or-add bg3.exe+0x2CF88B0 in the caller).

fields.name: SpellCheck
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 stores the byte its fifth argument points to: event +0x28 (SE FinishedEvent.SpellCheck, uint8_t).

fields.name: Canceled
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2CF8D10 stores the byte its sixth argument points to: event +0x29 (SE FinishedEvent.Canceled, bool).
